description: Ligand-superposed comparison of the purine pocket of ATP-specific Blastocystis SCS beta (6NO0, ADP) and GTP-specific pig SCS beta (2FP4, GTP): which residues line the base, which are conserved in position, and which differ
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("pdb", exist_ok=True)

def fetch(pid):
    p=f"pdb/{pid}.pdb"
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"w").write(r.text)
    return p
def parse(pid):
    rows=[]
    for line in open(fetch(pid)):
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el=="H": continue
            rows.append((line[:6].strip(),line[12:16].strip(),line[17:20].strip(),line[21],
                         int(line[22:26]),float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54]),el))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns="rec name resn chain resi x y z el".split())
X=lambda d: d[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(float)
RING=["N9","C8","N7","C5","C4","N3","C2","N1","C6"]
def kabsch(Q,P):
    cq,cp=Q.mean(0),P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((Q-cq).T@(P-cp))
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R, cp-R@cq

# --- ATP-specific Blastocystis beta nucleotide-binding domain with Mg-ADP
b=parse("6NO0")
adp=b[(b.resn=="ADP")]
adp=adp[adp.chain==adp.chain.iloc[0]]
# --- GTP-specific pig SCS, beta chain B with Mg-GTP
p=parse("2FP4")
gtp=p[(p.resn=="GTP")&(p.chain=="B")]
pb=p[(p.chain=="B")&(p.rec=="ATOM")]
bb=b[(b.rec=="ATOM")&(b.chain==adp.chain.iloc[0])]
print("6NO0 ADP atoms",len(adp)," protein atoms",len(bb))
print("2FP4 GTP atoms",len(gtp)," beta protein atoms",len(pb))

# superpose on the 9 purine ring atoms: move pig onto Blastocystis frame
A=np.array([X(adp[adp.name==n])[0] for n in RING])
G=np.array([X(gtp[gtp.name==n])[0] for n in RING])
R,t=kabsch(G,A)
rmsd=np.sqrt((((G@R.T)+t-A)**2).sum(1).mean())
print(f"\nligand-based superposition on 9 purine ring atoms: RMSD {rmsd:.3f} A")
pbX=(X(pb)@R.T)+t
gtpX=(X(gtp)@R.T)+t
cenA=A.mean(0)

# pocket residues within 5 A of any base atom (purine ring + exocyclic N6/O6/N2)
baseA_names=RING+["N6"]; baseG_names=RING+["O6","N2"]
BA=np.array([X(adp[adp.name==n])[0] for n in baseA_names if (adp.name==n).any()])
BG=np.array([(X(gtp[gtp.name==n])[0]@R.T)+t for n in baseG_names if (gtp.name==n).any()])

def pocket(prot, protX, base, tag):
    tr=cKDTree(protX); idx=sorted({i for s in tr.query_ball_point(base,5.0) for i in s})
    d=prot.iloc[idx].copy(); d["dmin"]=[np.linalg.norm(base-protX[i],axis=1).min() for i in idx]
    g=d.groupby(["resi","resn"]).dmin.min().reset_index().sort_values("dmin")
    g["src"]=tag
    return g, protX
pA,_=pocket(bb.reset_index(drop=True), X(bb.reset_index(drop=True)), BA, "6NO0 ATP-specific")
pG,_=pocket(pb.reset_index(drop=True), pbX, BG, "2FP4 GTP-specific")
print("\n--- base-lining residues, Blastocystis ATP-specific (6NO0), within 5 A of adenine ---")
print(pA.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- base-lining residues, pig GTP-specific (2FP4 beta), within 5 A of guanine, in the same frame ---")
print(pG.to_string(index=False))

# structural pairing: for each Blastocystis pocket residue, nearest pig pocket residue by CB (or CA) position
def rep(prot, protX, resi):
    m=prot.reset_index(drop=True); sel=m.index[(m.resi==resi)]
    sub=m.loc[sel]
    for nm in ("CB","CA"):
        if (sub.name==nm).any(): return protX[sel[(sub.name==nm).to_numpy()][0]]
    return protX[sel].mean(0)
bbr=bb.reset_index(drop=True); bbX=X(bbr); pbr=pb.reset_index(drop=True)
rowsP=[(int(r.resi),r.resn,rep(pbr,pbX,int(r.resi))) for r in pG.itertuples()]
pairs=[]
for r in pA.itertuples():
    c=rep(bbr,bbX,int(r.resi))
    ds=[(np.linalg.norm(c-q),ri,rn) for ri,rn,q in rowsP]
    ds.sort(); d0,ri,rn=ds[0]
    pairs.append(dict(blasto=f"{r.resn}{int(r.resi)}", d_base_A=round(r.dmin,2),
                      pig_nearest=f"{rn}{ri}", d_CB_A=round(d0,2),
                      identical=("yes" if rn==r.resn else "no")))
cmp=pd.DataFrame(pairs)
print("\n--- pairing each Blastocystis base-pocket residue with the structurally nearest pig base-pocket residue ---")
print(cmp.to_string(index=False))
cmp.to_csv("pocket_comparison.csv",index=False)
pd.concat([pA,pG]).to_csv("pocket_residues.csv",index=False)

n_same=(cmp.identical=="yes").sum()
print(f"\nidentical residue type at the structurally equivalent position: {n_same}/{len(cmp)}")
print("conserved:", ", ".join(cmp[cmp.identical=='yes'].blasto.tolist()))
print("differing:", ", ".join(f"{r.blasto}->{r.pig_nearest}" for r in cmp[cmp.identical=='no'].itertuples()))

# where do V113 and L227 (the LF mutant positions) sit?
for resi in (113,227,20,46,114):
    s=bbr[bbr.resi==resi]
    if len(s)==0: continue
    dm=np.linalg.norm(BA[:,None,:]-X(s)[None,:,:],axis=2).min()
    print(f"Blastocystis {s.resn.iloc[0]}{resi}: closest approach to adenine {dm:.2f} A")

# figure: distance of each pocket residue to the base, two enzymes side by side
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.6),sharex=True)
for a,(df,ttl,col) in zip(ax,[(pA,"Blastocystis SCSb, ATP specific (6NO0)","#3b6ea5"),
                              (pG,"Pig SCS beta, GTP specific (2FP4)","#a53b3b")]):
    lab=[f"{r.resn}{int(r.resi)}" for r in df.itertuples()]
    a.barh(range(len(df)), df.dmin, color=col)
    a.set_yticks(range(len(df))); a.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); a.invert_yaxis()
    a.set_xlabel("closest approach to purine base (A)"); a.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10)
    a.axvline(3.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
fig.suptitle("Residues lining the purine base, after superposition on the 9 ring atoms (RMSD %.2f A)"%rmsd,fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nartifacts in", os.getcwd(), ":")
print(sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith((".csv",".png",".npy"))))
